description: [Commercial Transit / Mobility] Metasearch of commercial passenger flights globally. Returns ranked options with option_id ready for affiliate deep-link generation. Does not book directly — acts as affiliate metasearch layer.

destination.description: Destination IATA code or city name (e.g. BCN, MIA, GVA, Barcelona)

origin.description: Origin IATA code or city name (e.g. MAD, JFK, ZRH, Madrid)

return_date.description: Optional return date in YYYY-MM-DD for round-trip

session_id.description: Optional product session id. If omitted, GEO360 creates one (trip_*). Pass the same id on later search/commit calls for the same trip.

sub_id.description: Optional affiliate sub-ID for calling agent attribution (e.g. meta_muse, grok, custom_ref)

name: geo360_search_flights
